# Wellness City Lucknow Plots

> Independent plot sales service for Wellness City, the health-themed Lucknow Development Authority (LDA) township between Sultanpur Road and Kisan Path, Lucknow. Not the official LDA website. Listing updated 22 October 2026.

## Key facts
- Plot sizes on offer: 35, 72, 128, 162, 200 and 288 m² (all six sizes available)
- Location: between Sultanpur Road and Kisan Path, south-east Lucknow; about 12.4 km from Hazratganj, 14.3 km from Charbagh station, 17.8 km from Lucknow airport and 5.9 km from IT City (straight line)
- Township: health-themed, with a dedicated medical and hospital zone; developed by LDA through land pooling. Reported area between about 1,200 acres (485 ha) and 1,474 acres (figures differ between reports)
- Villages: Bakkas, Malukpur Dhakwa, Chaurahiya, Chaurasi, Dularmau, Noorpur Behta, Mastemau
- Sellers: landowners who received developed plots in LDA's land-pooling lotteries (25% of land returned as plots); first farmer lottery of 125 plots on 30 June 2026, second lottery of about 200 plots announced
- Transfer rule: in the notified Phase-1 area, a sale needs prior written permission from the District Collector, Lucknow. Permission status is shared for each plot with its price.
- Public LDA scheme: not announced as of 22 October 2026
- Prices: shared on enquiry
- Contact: WhatsApp / call +91 85950 02933
- Page: https://lucknowwellnesscity.in/

## Plot sizes
- 35 m² (377 sq ft, 42 sq yd)
- 72 m² (775 sq ft, 86 sq yd)
- 128 m² (1,378 sq ft, 153 sq yd)
- 162 m² (1,744 sq ft, 194 sq yd)
- 200 m² (2,153 sq ft, 239 sq yd)
- 288 m² (3,100 sq ft, 344 sq yd)
